app_info.subtitle: 生成原创图标，衔接 Icon Composer
app_info.description:
把应用想法和参考图转成有辨识度的图标。先提炼轮廓、留白、色彩与性格，用不同的视觉方向探索；名称可以只是轻微联想。

优先使用可用的内置生图能力。内置工具不可用时，先查看本机 Codex Profiles 和图片接口环境配置，列出候选地址供用户选择；确认 Imagegen 命令行路线后调用，也可选择已授权的 OpenRouter。第三方图片服务调用前确认实际地址与费用。参考图可参与图片生成，再通过真实的小尺寸预览比较效果。

选定后重建干净的 SVG 或透明图层，衔接 Apple Icon Composer，交付原生文档与 macOS 图标资源。先做低成本草稿，保留精确提示词、参考来源和实际费用，确认后再精修。需要本地工具及可用的生图能力；API 生图可能收费。

test_cases.user_prompt: Design three original icon directions for a small app that manages remote app instances. Keep the name association subtle.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the brief and existing assets, creates distinct silhouettes with an available authorized image tool, and shows compact previews without renaming the project.

test_cases.user_prompt: Use my attached reference to guide an original icon, preserving its bold contrast and generous space.
test_cases.expected_output: Distinguishes style guidance from copying a mark; when supported and authorized, supplies the reference to the selected generator and records its use.

test_cases.user_prompt: The eyes and ears in this mascot face different directions. Fix the head pose while keeping the palette.
test_cases.expected_output: Reworks connected head geometry so eyes, ears and muzzle share a coherent pose, then checks the result at small size.

test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare my selected icon for Icon Composer and a legacy macOS app.
test_cases.expected_output: Checks local platform tools, separates artwork from native validation, prepares suitable layers or clearly labels flattened artwork, and creates ICNS resources from a reviewed export. Reports unavailable native checks.

test_cases.description: Use the optional API route safely
test_cases.user_prompt: Use my already configured OpenRouter credential to generate one low-cost icon draft.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the authorized provider and process environment without asking for a key in chat; makes one request, preserves the prompt, saves the image and safe cost receipt, and does not automatically retry a failed request.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reset the password for my email account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke the icon design workflow or attempt account administration.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Calculate my monthly expenses from a spreadsheet.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke the icon design workflow; routes to an appropriate capability.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Deploy my API server and rotate its production credentials.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke the icon design workflow or perform unrelated deployments or credential changes.
